device_entry.name: Agilent E8357A 矢量网络分析仪
device_entry.description: 这是一台射频/微波矢量网络分析仪，用于扫频测量器件或网络的散射参数，如 S11、S21、S12 和 S22。实验中常用于表征滤波器、谐振器、传输线、电缆、放大器及其他高频器件的反射、传输与频率响应。
device_entry.description_en: This is an RF/microwave vector network analyzer used to perform swept-frequency measurements of scattering parameters such as S11, S21, S12, and S22. In the lab it is commonly used to characterize the reflection, transmission, and frequency response of filters, resonators, transmission lines, cables, amplifiers, and other high-frequency components.
